focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 小作文与图表/数据综合写作：IELTS Task 1 / TOEFL Integrated / 科研趋势报告（BP25–BP32）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 托福综合写作 / 学术争议正反交锋段（Point-by-Point Reading vs. Lecture Synthesis）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写托福综合写作（Integrated Writing）或文献争议交锋段：先用 1 句话精准概括阅读材料（或正方文献）的分论点，再用 2–3 句话详细呈现教授讲座（或反方实证）是如何釜底抽薪推翻该论点的。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: TOEFL Integrated Writing 主体段 / 论文理论争议辨析段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [正方/阅读论点概括 Reading Claim & Rationale]：The reading passage contends that [Claim A], arguing that [Reading's Supporting Mechanism].
S2 [反方/听力直接反驳 Lecture Direct Refutation]：The lecturer directly challenges this assertion by pointing out that [Core Flaw / Neglected Factor in Reading's Premise].
S3 [反方具体反证展开 Empirical Counter-Evidence]：Specifically, she explains that when [Real-World Condition], [Mechanism B occurs instead], which [Negates the Claimed Benefit].
S4 [结论锁定 Refutation Closure]：Consequently, rather than achieving [Reading's Goal], the proposed measure actually exacerbates [Negative Outcome].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Reading Claim -> Lecturer's Direct Challenge -> Specific Counter-Mechanism -> Reversed Outcome. 绑定逻辑规则：L008, L019.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: The reading says that replacing all delivery trucks with autonomous drones will save energy. The professor disagrees. She says drones use a lot of battery to stay in the air and can only carry one package at a time.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 句式碎片化（The reading says... The professor disagrees. She says...），缺乏紧凑的逻辑因果嵌套。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: The reading passage contends that replacing urban delivery vans with autonomous quadcopter drones will substantially reduce last-mile transportation energy consumption, citing the lighter weight of aerial vehicles. The lecturer directly challenges this premise by examining energy efficiency per kilogram of delivered freight. Specifically, she points out that unlike ground vehicles supported passively by road surfaces, multi-rotor drones must expend continuous battery power simply to counteract gravity and headwinds while carrying only a single parcel per trip. Consequently, servicing a dense apartment block via individual drone flights consumes nearly three times more energy per package than a single consolidated van route.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 演讲中化繁为简讲解核心公式与算法直觉（Explaining Math Orally）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在 PPT 上出现核心损失函数或注意力公式时，用 4 句通俗、精准的口语把公式背后的物理/几何直觉讲透，而不是在台上干巴巴念希腊字母。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 学术演讲方法详解页（Explaining Equations on Slides）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [先讲直觉目标 Intuition First]：Before looking at the math at the bottom of the slide, here is the simple physical intuition we want to capture.
S2 [日常/物理类比 Physical Analogy]：When two sensors monitor the same mechanical shaft, genuine vibrations share a consistent phase lag, whereas random electrical glitches fire out of phase.
S3 [指向公式核心项 Point to Key Term]：That is exactly what the red penalty term $\|\Delta \Phi\|_1$ inside the softmax does: it measures phase mismatch between channels.
S4 [一句话总结效果 Operational Effect]：Whenever two channels fall out of phase, this term suppresses their attention weight automatically.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Intuition Before Symbols -> Physical Reality -> Pointer to Highlighted Math Term -> Operational Effect. 绑定逻辑规则：L014, L018.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: The formula on this slide is Q times K transpose divided by square root of d minus lambda times delta phi L1 norm, and then softmax times V.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 在台上把公式符号逐字念一遍（Q times K transpose divided by...）是学术演讲的大忌，听众听得云里雾里。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Before looking at the equation in the middle box, here is the physical intuition behind it. When two sensors sit on the same turbine shaft, genuine mechanical vibrations travel with a consistent phase lag, whereas random sensor glitches fire completely out of phase. That physical rule is captured by the highlighted red term, $\|\Delta \Phi_{Q,K}\|_1$, right inside the softmax. Whenever two channels show inconsistent phase lag, this penalty automatically zeroes out their attention weight.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 小作文与图表/数据综合写作：IELTS Task 1 / TOEFL Integrated / 科研趋势报告（BP25–BP32）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 异常数据点（Outliers）与局部背离现象精准批注段（Outlier & Anomaly Annotation）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在图表或实验结果段中，专门挑出违背总体规律的 1–2 个异常点（Outliers）或局部反常尖峰进行精准描述与成因剖析。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: IELTS Task 1 特例段 / 论文实验反常现象（Anomalous Observation）剖析段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [总体规律背景下的特例锚定 Outlier Identification]：Although [General Trend holds across most groups/steps], a notable departure from this pattern occurs in [Specific Point/Group].
S2 [反常幅度量化 Quantitative Deviation]：Whereas peer categories cluster tightly within $[A, B]$, [Outlier Entity] spikes/drops to [Extreme Value], deviating by more than [X%] from the group median.
S3 [底层物理/统计成因剖析 Root Cause Analysis]：Closer inspection indicates that this anomaly stems from [Specific Structural/External Factor] rather than random variance.
S4 [方法论启示 Methodological Implication]：Accounting for such localized departures is critical when calibrating [Downstream Model/Policy].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: General Rule vs. Notable Departure -> Quantitative Deviation -> Root Cause Attribution -> Calibration Takeaway. 绑定逻辑规则：L007, L013.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Most datasets follow this rule, except Exchange dataset. On Exchange dataset, deep models are worse than simple linear models. This is because financial data has strong random walk noise.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 表达平淡（follow this rule, except, worse than），缺乏量化的偏离描述与深层统计定性。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Although deep spectral transformers outperform linear baselines across six of the seven benchmarks, a notable departure emerges on the financial Exchange-Rate dataset. Whereas complex attention models reduce MSE by 12%–18% on periodic energy and weather streams, they trail a single-layer DLinear baseline by 4.3% on Exchange-Rate. Autocorrelation analysis reveals that this reversal stems from the near-martingale nature of daily currency returns, where weak seasonal periodicity causes high-capacity attention layers to overfit transient market shocks. This anomaly confirms that model capacity must be matched to the intrinsic signal-to-noise ratio of the underlying stochastic process.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 旧信息在前、新信息在后原则（Given-to-New Principle）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 英语段落连贯的第一动力不是连接词，而是每一句的句首（主位 Theme）承接上一句句末已经出现过的概念（旧信息 Given），再在句末（述位 Rheme）抛出本句真正要推进的核心增量（新信息 New）。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Sentence A: [Subject X] -> [Verb] -> [New Concept Y]. | Sentence B: [This/Such Y or Pronoun] -> [Verb] -> [New Concept Z].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 每一句都突兀地以一个全新概念作长主语，而把指代上一句的词塞在句尾，导致读者每读一句都要重新建立思维锚点。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Autoregressive transformers suffer from severe error accumulation over long horizons. A sudden distribution shift in non-stationary sensor streams further amplifies this error accumulation.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Autoregressive transformers suffer from severe error accumulation over long horizons. This cumulative drift accelerates sharply when non-stationary sensor streams undergo sudden distribution shifts.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 修改前第二句以长新名词 A sudden distribution shift... 开头，旧信息 this error accumulation 被甩在句末；修改后第二句用 This cumulative drift 紧扣上一句句尾的 error accumulation，再引出新信息 distribution shifts，段落瞬间丝滑。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 分类矩阵综述法：拒绝 A did X, B did Y 流水账（Taxonomy over Laundry List）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Taxonomic Synthesis vs. Chronological Laundry List
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 撰写 Related Work 或文献背景段时，严禁以人名作主语逐句罗列（Smith (2022) proposed X. Lee (2023) proposed Y. Wang (2024) used Z.）。必须以“方法流派/技术范式”为主语进行聚类，把文献引用退居句尾括号或作同位语例证。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Existing approaches to [Problem] fall into two primary paradigms: [Paradigm A] and [Paradigm B]. [Paradigm A] methods (e.g., [1, 2]) rely on..., whereas [Paradigm B] architectures [3, 4] leverage... However, neither paradigm resolves [Core Bottleneck].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 连续 6 句话全部是 [Author] et al. proposed/introduced/developed...，只有罗列没有批判性归类。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Wu et al. proposed Autoformer in 2021. Zhou et al. proposed FEDformer in 2022. Nie et al. proposed PatchTST in 2023. They all improved time series forecasting.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Recent deep forecasters mitigate long-range attention complexity either by decomposing seasonal-trend components in the frequency domain (e.g., Autoformer, FEDformer) or by aggregating local sub-series into channel-independent patches (e.g., PatchTST). Yet both paradigms treat cross-variable correlations as static over time, overlooking transient inter-sensor coupling during system faults.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 两句话完成流派二分法归纳 + 代表作锚定 + 共同盲区提炼，学术密度提升数倍。

focal_revision_cases.domain_en: Academic Tech Talk & Conference Oral Delivery
focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 顶会口头汇报（Tech Talk）与图表引导
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写托福综合写作（Integrated Writing）或文献争议交锋段：先用 1 句话精准概括阅读材料（或正方文献）的分论点，再用 2–3 句话详细呈现教授讲座（或反方实证）是如何釜底抽薪推翻该论点的。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: The reading says that replacing all delivery trucks with autonomous drones will save energy. The professor disagrees. She says drones use a lot of battery to stay in the air and can only carry one package at a time.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L001 旧信息在前、新信息在后原则（Given-to-New Principle））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 句式碎片化（The reading says... The professor disagrees. She says...），缺乏紧凑的逻辑因果嵌套。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: The reading passage contends that replacing urban delivery vans with autonomous quadcopter drones will substantially reduce last-mile transportation energy consumption, citing the lighter weight of aerial vehicles. The lecturer directly challenges this premise by examining energy efficiency per kilogram of delivered freight. Specifically, she points out that unlike ground vehicles supported passively by road surfaces, multi-rotor drones must expend continuous battery power simply to counteract gravity and headwinds while carrying only a single parcel per trip. Consequently, servicing a dense apartment block via individual drone flights consumes nearly three times more energy per package than a single consolidated van route.

focal_revision_cases.domain_en: CET-6 & IELTS Task 2 Technology & Society Essay
focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 六级/雅思大作文：AI 自动化、教育与科研伦理
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想深入剖析现有方法在特定难题（如非平稳突变、长程自回归误差累积、Sim-to-Real 接触失配）上为什么会失效，把机理讲透。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: The problem of error accumulation in long-term forecasting and the losing of scale information when using RevIN normalization is very serious and hard to solve by simple ways.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L021 具象微观场景举例法：用一句话精确案例终结空洞模板（Micro-Case Grounding））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: ① 长达 21 词的巨型名词短语作主语（头重脚轻）；② 谓语表语极度空洞（is very serious and hard to solve by simple ways）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Bridging non-stationary robustness and amplitude fidelity remains a core bottleneck in long-horizon forecasting. While instance normalization strips time-varying mean and variance shifts to stabilize attention weights, it simultaneously erases physical scale cues required to predict extreme load peaks. Conversely, retaining raw unnormalized inputs exposes self-attention layers to severe covariate shift, causing validation error to diverge over extended horizons. Resolving this tension requires a mechanism that disentangles intrinsic temporal dynamics from transient scale drift without discarding magnitude information.

focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: In recent years, many works studied time series foundation models. TimeGPT trained a transformer on large data. Moment used masked pre-training. Chronos quantized time series into tokens. Lag-Llama used lag features. However, our model is different from them.

第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Pre-trained time series foundation models generally follow either continuous patch reconstruction or discrete vocabulary tokenization. Continuous reconstruction frameworks (e.g., PatchTST, MOMENT) pre-train encoders via masked patch regression, preserving fine-grained numerical resolution across continuous domains. Conversely, discrete tokenization approaches (e.g., Chronos) quantize scaled observations into fixed bins to leverage cross-entropy language modeling objectives. Despite their zero-shot transferability, both paradigms treat univariate channels independently during pre-training, ignoring physical cross-variable conservation laws that govern multivariate engineering systems.
